notes: Ibn Abbas and Aisha are asked by عمران and only refer him on («سل عائشة»، «سل عبد الله بن عمر»): they are in the scene, not transmitters of the saying, so they are left out (rule 6).
«حدثني أبو حفص» — the Companion whose words the Prophet's prohibition is relayed through; the kunya is written as the text has it.
